name: meeaww
description: All-in-one AI creative studio: make and edit videos and images with multiple AI models, including product ad videos from a product link or photos.

interface.longDescription:
MeeAww is an all-in-one AI creative studio. Make and edit videos and images with multiple AI models, directed from your chat. Product ads are one of the things it makes: from a product link or product photos, it makes short-form ad videos and ad images for sellers and marketers.

Tell ChatGPT what you want to make. MeeAww opens a production project and asks you to make the choices that matter, such as the style and an on-screen character: the options appear as numbered cards with photos, and you reply in chat with your choice. It then draws a storyboard and shows it to you for approval. Video generation starts only after you approve the storyboard in chat. MeeAww then renders the video (usually 7 to 16 minutes), shows progress while it works, and lets you review the result and confirm the one you want.

What you can make:
- Videos such as greetings and celebrations, with or without photos
- Cinematic short dramas with Drama Studio: a consistent look, timed shots, your characters' lines, and actors you saved in MeeAww
- Images, and edits or retouches of your own photos
- UGC-style product ads with a character, voice, and background music
- Ad images and storyboard images

You sign in with your MeeAww account when you connect. A new account is created if you do not have one.
defaultPrompt: Make a short birthday video for my friend
Make a 15-second UGC ad for this product: <product link>
Show me trending video ads for collagen serum

positive.description: Product ad video from a product link, end to end
positive.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical UGC-style ad for this serum: https://mixsoon.co.kr/product/detail.html?product_no=880
positive.tools_triggered: agent_start_run, import_product_source, agent_choose, list_human_models, select_human_model, record_note, generate_image, request_storyboard_approval
positive.expected_behavior: Opens a project and reads the product page. Asks for the ad style and then a character: the options appear as numbered cards (characters with photos) and the user replies in chat with a number. Then shows a storyboard card with the story and the credit cost (60 credits for one 15-second take) and asks the user to reply in chat to approve. No video is generated before approval.

positive.description: Approving the storyboard renders the video
positive.expected_behavior: Records the approval, starts the video take, shows a progress card while it renders (usually 7 to 16 minutes), then shows the finished video in a viewer and asks the user to confirm it.

positive.description: General video without a product or photos
positive.prompt: Make a short, cheerful 15-second birthday celebration video. No names needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the mood as a numbered list (the user replies in chat), draws a storyboard, and shows it with the credit cost for approval.

positive.description: Competitor ad research before making an ad
positive.prompt: Show me trending video ads for collagen serum so I can pick a style.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent paid video ads for the keyword with advertisers and ad copy, and offers to use one as a style reference. Free.

positive.description: Checking a video that is still rendering
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the user's latest project, reports whether the video is still rendering or done, and shows it in the viewer when it is done.

positive.description: Cinematic short drama with Drama Studio
positive.prompt: Make a 10-second cinematic noir short with Drama Studio: two lovers say goodbye in a rainy alley at night.
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses the look (genre, color palette, lens, light) itself instead of asking for each one, draws the two characters and a key still in that look, then shows a storyboard card with the timed shots, each character's lines and the credit cost, and asks the user to reply in chat to approve. No video is generated before approval.

positive.description: Showing the Drama Studio options when asked
positive.prompt: Show me which Drama Studio options you picked and what else I can choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the look options (camera, lens, aperture, light, color palette, genre, era, pacing), camera movements and emotions by their labels, marks what this project uses now, and changes them only when the user asks. Free.

positive.description: Casting an actor the user saved in MeeAww
positive.prompt: Use my saved Drama Studio actor for a short cafe scene where she apologizes to a friend.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the user's saved actors as numbered cards with photos and waits for the user's choice in chat. With no saved actor it says so and offers to create one first. Free until the video is approved.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seoul tomorrow?
Book me a flight from Seoul to Tokyo next Friday.

negative.description: Unrelated writing request with no image or video
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.

publication.release_notes: Describes MeeAww as an all-in-one AI creative studio for videos and images, with product ads as one use. Direct videos, images, and product ad videos from ChatGPT with storyboard approval before any paid generation. Adds a Korean (ko-KR) listing translation.

ko-KR.subtitle: AI 영상·이미지 스튜디오
ko-KR.description:
미우(MeeAww)는 여러 AI 모델로 영상과 이미지를 만들고 편집하는 올인원 AI 크리에이티브 스튜디오입니다. 채팅으로 원하는 것을 말하면 미우가 만들어 드립니다. 제품 광고도 그중 하나로, 제품 링크나 제품 사진으로 판매자·마케터를 위한 숏폼 광고 영상과 광고 이미지를 만듭니다.

ChatGPT에 만들고 싶은 것을 말해 주세요. 미우가 제작 프로젝트를 열고 스타일, 화면에 나올 캐릭터처럼 중요한 선택을 여쭤봅니다. 선택지는 사진이 들어간 번호 카드로 보이고, 채팅으로 답하시면 됩니다. 그다음 콘티를 그려 보여 드리고 승인을 받습니다. 영상 생성은 채팅에서 콘티를 승인하신 뒤에만 시작합니다. 영상은 보통 7~16분 걸리며, 만드는 동안 진행 상황을 보여 드리고, 완성되면 결과를 확인하고 마음에 드는 것을 확정하실 수 있습니다.

만들 수 있는 것:
- 인사·축하 영상 같은 짧은 영상(사진이 있어도, 없어도 됩니다)
- 드라마 스튜디오로 만드는 시네마틱 단편 드라마: 일관된 룩, 초 단위 샷, 인물별 대사, MeeAww 에 저장한 배우
- 이미지, 그리고 내 사진 편집·보정
- 캐릭터·목소리·배경음악이 들어간 UGC 스타일 제품 광고
- 광고 이미지와 콘티 이미지

연결할 때 미우 계정으로 로그인합니다. 계정이 없으면 새로 만들어집니다.
